normalization_notes: Candidate missing Fridays are calculated within the continuous mailbox inventory beginning 2016-04-01; the earlier 2015 records are public-source backfills and do not imply continuous coverage.
Saturday, Sunday, and delayed special-edition deliveries are assigned to their newsletter week’s Friday.
Special subjects such as 6-Bullet Saturday, 11-Bullet Friday, and Mega 5-Bullet Friday are included.
